metadata.description: Sandbox marketplace for the AI SDLC framework: orchestration engine, plus the spec/eval, tech-design, implementation, documentation, and testing agents.

plugins.name: orchestration-engine
plugins.description: The AI SDLC conductor: /sdlc runs complexity routing, the gated pipeline, deterministic verification, draft-PR delivery and a retro; hooks enforce sequencing and verification-before-done; run history and a capped, human-approved lessons file live in the repo.

plugins.name: sdlc-agents
plugins.description: The six AI SDLC pipeline agents (spec-eval, tech-design, tech-design-eval, implementation, documentation, testing) for ServiceNow scripted REST, Kafka and .NET work, reporting draft / ask_clarification / decline decisions and approve / revise verdicts.
